VI.description: Draws one frame for a picture control that never erases, as a list of pieces (image data with their screen rectangle). Full redraw (new room, level, message, floor phase or light mode): the HUD and the whole playfield, on the title the title card. Otherwise only: the piece around the last three positions of Claude, one piece per enemy, the piece where the light moved (dark room) and the HUD when a value changed. Memory keeps the room pictures, the composite of the dark room and the last positions. Picture = all pieces drawn in order.
